name: Oficina — Operação
description: Visão de negócio das ordens de serviço: volume, tempo por status e erros de integração. Uma página por ambiente. Fonte: eventos de log estruturado emitidos pelo app (os.created, os.status.changed, integration.error).

pages.name: Homolog
pages.description: Ambiente de homologação (namespace homolog / appName oficina-os-service-homolog).

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'OS criadas' FROM Log WHERE event = 'os.created' AND (entity.name = 'oficina-os-service-homolog' OR (namespace_name = 'homolog' AND container_name = 'os-service')) SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Volume diário de ordens de serviço

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE event = 'os.created' AND (entity.name = 'oficina-os-service-homolog' OR (namespace_name = 'homolog' AND container_name = 'os-service')) SINCE 30 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day

widgets.title: Tempo médio de execução por status (minutos)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(numeric(durationMs)) / 60000 AS 'minutos' FROM Log WHERE event = 'os.status.changed' AND (entity.name = 'oficina-os-service-homolog' OR (namespace_name = 'homolog' AND container_name = 'os-service')) FACET fromStatus SINCE 7 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE event = 'os.status.changed' AND (entity.name = 'oficina-os-service-homolog' OR (namespace_name = 'homolog' AND container_name = 'os-service')) FACET toStatus SINCE 1 day ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE event = 'integration.error' AND (entity.name = 'oficina-os-service-homolog' OR (namespace_name = 'homolog' AND container_name = 'os-service')) FACET integration SINCE 7 days ago TIMESERIES

SELECT timestamp, integration, osNumero, error, requestId FROM Log WHERE event = 'integration.error' AND (entity.name = 'oficina-os-service-homolog' OR (namespace_name = 'homolog' AND container_name = 'os-service')) SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE event = 'integration.error' AND (entity.name = 'oficina-os-service-prod' OR (namespace_name = 'prod' AND container_name = 'os-service')) FACET integration SINCE 7 days ago TIMESERIES
